name: Local Pickup Discount for WooCommerce
author: WPMajestic

sections.description:
Local Pickup Discount for WooCommerce allows you to offer a percentage-based discount when customers select local pickup as their shipping method. This can encourage more local sales while saving customers money.

Key Features:

  • Set a custom percentage discount for local pickup orders
  • Discount is automatically applied at checkout
  • High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) Compatible
  • Compatible with WooCommerce Blocks checkout
  • Compatible with classic WooCommerce checkout
  • Displays informative notices encouraging customers to use local pickup
  • Clear discount information displayed during checkout
  • Option to make discounts taxable or non-taxable

Usage

  1. Make sure you have set up Local Pickup as a shipping method in WooCommerce.
  2. Go to ‘WooCommerce → Local Pickup Discount’ in your WordPress admin.
  3. Enter the percentage discount you want to offer for local pickup orders.
  4. Save your settings.

When customers select the local pickup shipping method at checkout, the discount will be automatically applied.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/local-pickup-discount-for-woocommerce directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to ‘WooCommerce → Local Pickup Discount’ to configure your discount percentage.
sections.faq:
Does this work with the new WooCommerce Blocks checkout?

Yes, this plugin is compatible with both the traditional WooCommerce checkout experience and the new WooCommerce Blocks checkout.

Can I set different discount amounts for different local pickup methods?

Currently, the plugin applies the same discount percentage to all local pickup methods.

Is the discount applied to the entire order?

Yes, the discount is calculated based on the cart subtotal (before tax and shipping).

Will customers know about the discount before selecting local pickup?

Yes, the plugin displays a notice on the cart and checkout pages informing customers they can save money by selecting local pickup.
